# SCIM 2.0 schemas: attributes and characteristics

From the schema representations in RFC 7643 section 8.7 (<https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7643#section-8.7>). Defaults when a characteristic is not listed: `required` false, `caseExact` false, `mutability` readWrite, `returned` default, `uniqueness` none, `multiValued` false (RFC 7643 section 2.2). Common attributes `id`, `externalId`, `meta` (section 3.1) apply to every resource and are not repeated below.

## Common attributes (every resource, RFC 7643 section 3.1)

Not part of the schema representations; characteristics as section 3.1 describes them. `id` is unique across the service provider, assigned by it, never `bulkId`; `externalId` belongs to the client.

| Attribute | Type | Multi | Required | Case exact | Mutability | Returned | Uniqueness | Canonical values / reference types |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  |  | yes | readOnly | always | server |  |
| `externalId` | string |  |  | yes | readWrite |  |  |  |
| `meta` | complex |  |  |  | readOnly |  |  |  |
| `meta.resourceType` | string |  |  | yes | readOnly |  |  |  |
| `meta.created` | dateTime |  |  |  | readOnly |  |  |  |
| `meta.lastModified` | dateTime |  |  |  | readOnly |  |  |  |
| `meta.location` | reference |  |  |  | readOnly |  |  | uri |
| `meta.version` | string |  |  | yes | readOnly |  |  |  |

## Default sub-attributes of multi-valued attributes (RFC 7643 section 2.4)

Apply when a multi-valued complex attribute does not define its own: `type`, `primary` (true at most once), `display` (immutable), `value`, `$ref`.
